assessment.rationale: Fixed AS/RS has decades of installed base, established integrators and standard financing, and Symbotic-style case-handling systems are now scaling across grocery distribution under multi-year programmes. Nothing about the technology is in question; the buying decision is capital allocation.
advance_criteria: Already mature; watch the shift from pallet AS/RS to case- and tote-level systems
regress_criteria: None plausible for the installed technology
